answer: Sustained-Attention Ledge: each identity must hold a scarce, non-transferable time-slot in a global attention kernel for E epochs. Slots are allocated by continuous auction; holders must answer sporadic context checks seeded by a dune beacon within 300 ms. Missing checks frees the ledge and resets tenure. A sybil operator needs N concurrent slots and N live low-latency responders, paying auction rent plus foregone high-value task execution; because slots are capped and tenure-gated, cost scales linearly and cannot be amortized across identities.
